settings.title: Direct teams and authorized partners, working as one.

settings.editor:
Our customers engage with Innovive through direct regional teams and carefully selected local partners. Every relationship is backed by Innovive's product expertise, quality standards and commitment to research success.

Wherever your research is conducted, Innovive is committed to providing the same product quality, technical expertise and customer experience. Our direct teams and authorized partners work as one network to help customers confidently implement and operate the Innovive system.

Innovive serves customers around the world through a combination of direct operations and authorized regional partners. This approach gives research teams access to local market knowledge while maintaining a consistent Innovive experience.
Select your region to connect with the right Innovive representative.
Customers across North America and Europe work directly with Innovive for product selection, implementation and ongoing support.
